epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Visual regression diff ratio <= 0.01% against approved design mockup
epics.tocConstraintRef: Frontend UI alignment and styling fidelity bottleneck
requirements: R1: Implement UI updates pixel-perfect against the approved design mockup design/approved/20261118104023-mockup/mockup.html without modifying backend contracts or data schemas.

slices.title: Implement pixel-perfect UI updates matching approved mockup
slices.jtbd: When implementing frontend layout updates for this epic, I want to mirror the styling and structure of design/approved/20261118104023-mockup/mockup.html directly in the existing web client, so that the knowledge base presentation achieves full visual and responsive fidelity.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved mockup at design/approved/20261118104023-mockup/mockup.html,
When the frontend components in src/main/resources/static/index.html and related client assets are updated,
Then the rendered layout, colors, typography, and responsive breakpoints match the approved design reference pixel-perfect with zero regressions on existing search interactions.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Static UI layout and style token compliance
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% visual layout element match against approved mockup
